title: PongLens
tagline: Help your students play better matches.
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a coach explaining something useful to another coach. Unhurried and even, with the confidence to leave a word alone rather than push it. Nothing is sold and nothing is hurried. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens is where table tennis coaches get paid to review their students' matches.
You decide what a review includes, what it costs, and how many days you need.
lines.label: What you sell

lines.text: Start from a serve review, a receive review or a full match review, and change any part of it.
lines.label: What you sell

lines.text: Everything you sell sits on your profile page, along with your background, your offerings, and the testimonials your students have left you.
lines.label: Your page

lines.text: Send that link to your students, or put the code up at the club.
lines.label: Your page

lines.text: Payments run through Stripe. You connect it once, and it pays your bank.
lines.label: Getting set up

lines.text: When a student buys a review, they send you one of their matches and answer your questions.
lines.label: A new order

lines.text: You read their answers before you decide, then accept or decline. Nothing starts until you accept.
lines.label: A new order

lines.text: The match arrives with the standing around already cut out. Every point is its own clip, with the score on the picture.
lines.label: What arrives

lines.text: You are not hunting for a rally. You watch, and the same mistake turns up more than once.
lines.label: Finding the pattern

lines.text: When you see it, name it. That is a pattern, and it holds everything you want to say about one habit.
lines.label: Finding the pattern

lines.text: Draw on the frame if a picture says it faster, or leave a voice note on it.
lines.label: Finding the pattern

lines.text: Then every time that habit shows up again, add that point to the same pattern. By the end your student has the proof, not just your word for it.
lines.label: Finding the pattern

lines.text: The write-up is built to be quick. Speak it instead of typing, and your words arrive as text.
lines.label: The write-up

lines.text: Tidy up turns rough notes into clean sentences. It only edits what you wrote, so it still sounds like you.
lines.label: The write-up

lines.text: And Review checks it before it goes: every section written, a pattern with points on it, long enough for the price, and their questions answered.
lines.label: The write-up

lines.text: If you already have your own drills or a plan written up, attach the file and it goes with the review.
lines.label: The write-up

lines.text: Your student gets your write-up, and a clip for every point you linked. It stays in their account.
lines.label: What they get

lines.text: When the review is finished, Stripe sends your share to your bank.
lines.label: Getting paid

lines.text: PongLens. Get paid for the coaching you already do.
